hints.The Matrix: Lean far back to dodge bullets in slow motion, put on dark glasses, and reach out to take one of two pills.
hints.Inception: Spin a top and watch it, then bend space by folding the world over you and show falling asleep inside a dream inside a dream.
hints.Forrest Gump: Sit on a bench with a box of chocolates, run and run in a long straight line, and shrug with a simple, gentle smile.
hints.Pirates of the Caribbean: Wobble drunk on a ship deck with a wide swagger, swing a sword, wear a hat and look for treasure with an eye patch.
hints.Back to the Future: Check your watch, sit in a fast car, speed up until sparks fly, and show time going backwards, then look at a clock.
hints.The Godfather: Stroke a cat in your lap, hunch your shoulders with a low, brooding look, hold your cheek with a stern face, and offer something nobody can refuse.
hints.Gladiator: Fight with a sword and shield in an arena as a crowd roars, then turn to the emperor with a thumb pointing down or up.
hints.Mission Impossible: Hang from a rope above a floor, descend very slowly without touching it, hold your breath, and show a fuse burning.
hints.The Lion King: Lift a baby up high on a rock, paw the air like a lion, and act as a lion cub growing up, with a long mane.
hints.Harry Potter: Draw round glasses and a lightning scar on your forehead, swish a wand, and ride a broomstick.
hints.Jurassic Park: Stomp like a huge dinosaur with tiny arms and snapping jaws, and a cup of water ripples as it steps.
hints.Star Wars: Hold a glowing sword and swing it, breathe heavily like a dark mask, and reach a hand out toward someone.
hints.Home Alone: Put both hands on your cheeks with your mouth wide open in shock, then set clever traps for clumsy burglars.
hints.Kung Fu Panda: Show a big round belly and eat a lot, then bow, do kung fu moves, and fall over.
hints.Ghostbusters: Carry a heavy pack on your back, shoot a beam at a ghost, and trap it in a box.
hints.Cinderella: Scrub the floor, then dress for a ball, dance, lose one shoe running away at midnight, and try on a slipper.
